title: HSK Passport Issuer Metadata
description: Off-chain metadata for an HSK Passport issuer. Hosted at the issuer's metadataURI on the IssuerRegistry contract. The on-chain registry stores stake, tier, and reputation; this JSON describes the operating entity behind the address.

name.description: Operating name of the issuer (legal entity or product brand).

website.description: Public homepage. Must use https:// or ipfs:// scheme.

email.description: Operational contact for compliance, security, or revocation requests.

kycMethod.description: KYC provider used to verify holders. 'in-house' indicates a proprietary process; 'other' requires kycMethodNotes.

kycMethodNotes.description: Brief description of the verification process. Required if kycMethod is 'other' or 'in-house'.

jurisdictions.description: Country codes the issuer can verify holders for.

regulatoryLicenses.description: Optional. Public regulatory licenses backing this issuer's operating mandate.

supportedCredentials.description: Credential types this issuer is requesting authority to issue. Final approval is on-chain via approveIssuer + delegate assignments.

keyCustody.description: How the issuer key is held. 'hot-wallet' is acceptable for Tier 1 only.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the issuer signed and published this metadata.

logoURL.description: Optional public logo. Recommended 512x512 PNG or SVG.
